# Rafiq v0.5.17: Rafiq, in your terminal

## New
- **`rafiq` in the terminal.** Type `rafiq` in any terminal for a full chat on the current folder: the reply streams, each tool step shows with its result, and a step that needs permission asks right there. The app doesn't need to be open: Rafiq starts its own agent and stops it when you leave (or close the window). If the app opens meanwhile, the terminal carries on with the app's agent, same chats, same data.
  - Commands: `/model`, `/mode`, `/lang`, `/new`, `/clear`, `/resume`, `/compact`, `/cost`, `/status`, `/init`, `/memory`, `/tasks`, `/mcp`, `/skills`, `/folder`, `/help`.
  - Shift+Tab switches the mode: ask, accept edits, plan only, don't ask.
  - `!command` runs a command here and sends its output with your next message, `# note` keeps a note in Rafiq's memory, `@` completes a file name.
  - **Arabic, English and Russian:** `/lang` switches the terminal's language and remembers it (`rafiq --lang en` for one run). Arabic reads right to left even in terminals that don't support it, and JetBrains terminals are left to do it themselves.
- **Rafiq inside your code editor.** Zed, JetBrains and any editor that speaks ACP can use Rafiq as an agent: Settings → Tasks and models → «Rafiq inside your code editor» has the settings to copy.
- **Smart approvals.** Before a permission card appears, a second model reads what you asked for and what the step does. If it serves your request and can't do damage that can't be undone, it runs and the chat says why; otherwise you're asked as usual, with its view. Deleting, publishing, messages and screen control always ask. Settings → Permissions.
- **A free model on your computer.** Models → «A free model on your computer» installs Ollama (its signed installer) and downloads a model that speaks Arabic and uses tools. No key, no card.
- **Scanned PDFs in the knowledge base.** Each page becomes a picture that a vision model reads, Arabic or English, with page numbers. Settings → Memory → Knowledge.
- **Ready-made skills.** A catalog of ten skills by category, added in one click.

## Good to know
- The installer puts `rafiq` on your PATH. Open a new terminal after installing (an IDE needs a full restart to see it).
- `RAFIQ_BIDI=0` or `1` overrides how the terminal handles Arabic, if it looks wrong in yours.

## Updating
Rafiq offers the update by itself. Or download `Rafiq_0.5.17_x64-setup.exe` below and check it:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.5.17_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the result with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

macOS (Apple Silicon): [Rafiq-macos-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/AhmadALSaffan/RAFIQ/releases/download/macos/Rafiq-macos-arm64.dmg).
